The United States on Friday (November 13, 2026) lifted a four-hour nationwide airport ground stop that disrupted air travel across the country. The FAA order led to more than 6,600 flight cancellations and 8,600 delays, leaving thousands of passengers stranded. Officials ruled out a cyberattack and a widespread Microsoft outage. A ground stop is an air traffic control measure that temporarily halts departing flights at their airports of origin.
Thank you for watching our video!
